ayahs.textUthmani: حمٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: حمٓ ۝١
ayahs.translation: Ḥā, Meem.[1429]
ayahs.transliteration: Haa-Meeem
ayahs.translationClear: Ha, Meem.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالۡكِتٰبِ الۡمُبِيۡنِ ​ ۛ​ۙ‏
ayahs.translation: By the clear Book,
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-Kitaabil Mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: By the Book that makes things clear.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡءٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ​ۚ‏
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa ja'alnaahu Quraanan 'Arabiyyal la'allakum ta'qiloon
ayahs.translationClear: We made it an Arabic Quran, so that you may understand.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّهٗ فِىۡۤ اُمِّ الۡكِتٰبِ لَدَيۡنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيۡمٌؕ‏
ayahs.translation: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book[1430] with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.[1431]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-innahoo feee Ummil Kitaabi Ladainaa la'aliyyun hakeem
ayahs.translationClear: And it is with Us, in the Source Book, sublime and wise.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفَنَضۡرِبُ عَنۡكُمُ الذِّكۡرَ صَفۡحًا اَنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمًا مُّسۡرِفِيۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
ayahs.transliteration: Afa-nadribu 'ankumuz Thikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeen
ayahs.translationClear: Shall We hold back the Reminder from you, since you are a transgressing people?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَمۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ نَّبِىٍّ فِى الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-kam arsalnaa min Nabiyyin fil awwaleen
ayahs.translationClear: How many a prophet did We send to the ancients?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ نَّبِىٍّ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maa ya'teehim min Nabiyyin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
ayahs.translationClear: No messenger came to them, but they ridiculed him.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَهۡلَـكۡنَاۤ اَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ بَطۡشًا وَّمَضٰى مَثَلُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And We destroyed greater than them[1432] in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-ahlaknaaa ashadda minhum batshanw Wa-madaa masalul awwaleen

footnotes.1432: The disbelievers of the Quraysh, who denied Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ).

ayahs.translationClear: We destroyed people more powerful than they, and so the example of the ancients has passed away.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَٮِٕنۡ سَاَلۡتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡعَلِيۡمُۙ‏
ayahs.translation: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-la'in sa-altahum man khalaqas samaawaati wal-arda la-yaqoolunna khalaqa-hunnal 'Azeezul 'Aleem
ayahs.translationClear: And if you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” They would say, “The Mighty, the Knower created them.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: الَّذِىۡ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ مَهۡدًا وَّ جَعَلَ لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُوۡنَ​ۚ‏
ayahs.translation: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
ayahs.transliteration: Allathee ja'ala lakumul arda mahdanw Wa-ja'ala lakum feehaa subulan la'allakum tahtadoon
ayahs.translationClear: He who made the earth a habitat for you, and traced pathways for you on it, that you may be guided.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِىۡ نَزَّلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ​ۚ فَاَنۡشَرۡنَا بِهٖ بَلۡدَةً مَّيۡتًا​ ۚ كَذٰلِكَ تُخۡرَجُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
ayahs.transliteration: Wallathee nazzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an biqadarin fa-ansharnaa bihee baldatan maitaa' kathaalika tukhrajoon
ayahs.translationClear: He who sends down water from the sky in due proportion; and so We revive thereby a dead land. Thus you will be brought out.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالَّذِىۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَزۡوَاجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡفُلۡكِ وَالۡاَنۡعَامِ مَا تَرۡكَبُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.translation: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount
ayahs.transliteration: Wallathee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa Wa-ja'ala lakum minal fulki wal-an'aami maa tarkaboon
ayahs.translationClear: He who created all the pairs; and provided you with ships, and animals on which you ride.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: لِتَسۡتَوٗا عَلٰى ظُهُوۡرِهٖ ثُمَّ تَذۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَةَ رَبِّكُمۡ اِذَا اسۡتَوَيۡتُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ وَتَقُوۡلُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِىۡ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهٗ مُقۡرِنِيۡنَۙ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.[1433]
ayahs.transliteration: Litastawoo 'alaa zuhoorihee summa tathkuroo ni'mata Rabbikum ithas tawaitum 'alaihi Wa-taqooloo Subhaanal lathee sakhkhara lana haatha Wa-maa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen

footnotes.1433: Literally, "made it a companion" or "made it compatible."

ayahs.translationClear: That you may mount their backs, and remember the favor of your Lord as you sit firmly upon them, and say, “Glory be to Him who placed these at our service; surely we could not have done it by ourselves.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّاۤ اِلٰى رَبِّنَا لَمُنۡقَلِبُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-innaaa ilaa Rabbinaa lamunqaliboon
ayahs.translationClear: And surely, to our Lord we will return.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا‌ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَعَلُوۡا لَهٗ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ جُزۡءًا​ ؕ اِنَّ الۡاِنۡسَانَ لَـكَفُوۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ ؕ‏
ayahs.translation: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion.[1434] Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ja'aloo lahoo min 'ibaadihee juz'aa; innal insaana la-kafoorun mubeen

footnotes.1434: By claiming that He (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) has a son or daughters, as it is said that a child is part of his parent. This concept is totally incompatible with Allāh's unity and exclusiveness.

ayahs.translationClear: Yet they turn one of His servants into a part of Him. Man is clearly ungrateful.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمِ اتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخۡلُقُ بَنٰتٍ وَّاَصۡفٰٮكُمۡ بِالۡبَنِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
ayahs.transliteration: Amit takhatha mimmaa yakhluqu banaatinw Wa-asfaakum bilbaneen
ayahs.translationClear: Or has He chosen for Himself daughters from what He creates, and favored you with sons?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُمۡ بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهٗ مُسۡوَدًّا وَّهُوَ كَظِيۡمٌ‏
ayahs.translation: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ithaa bushshira ahaduhum bimaa daraba lir-Rahmaani masalan zalla wajhuhoo muswaddanw Wa-huwa kazeem
ayahs.translationClear: Yet when one of them is given news of what he attributes to the Most Gracious, his face darkens, and he suppresses grief.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَمَنۡ يُّنَشَّؤُا فِى الۡحِلۡيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى الۡخِصَامِ غَيۡرُ مُبِيۡنٍ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident[1435] [attributed to Allāh]?
ayahs.transliteration: Awa-maien yunashsha'u fil hilyati Wa-huwa fil khisaami ghairu mubeen

footnotes.1435: Not "obvious" or "distinct" in an argument. Or not "seen," i.e., absent from battles. The reference is to a daughter.

ayahs.translationClear: “Someone brought up to be beautiful, and unable to help in a fight?”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَـٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ إِنَـٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَـٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَـٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ إِنَـٰثًا‌ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ‌ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَـٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَعَلُوا الۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةَ الَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ عِبَادُ الرَّحۡمٰنِ اِنَاثًا​ ؕ اَشَهِدُوۡا خَلۡقَهُمۡ​ ؕ سَتُكۡتَبُ شَهَادَتُهُمۡ وَيُسۡـَٔــلُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ja'alul malaaa'ikatal latheena hum 'ibaadur Rahmaani inaasaa; 'a-shahidoo khalqahum; satuktabu shahaadatuhum Wa-yus'aloon
ayahs.translationClear: And they appoint the angels, who are servants to the Most Gracious, as females. Have they witnessed their creation? Their claim will be recorded, and they will be questioned.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَـٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَـٰهُم‌ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ‌ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡ شَآءَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مَا عَبَدۡنٰهُمۡ​ؕ مَا لَهُمۡ بِذٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍ​ اِنۡ هُمۡ اِلَّا يَخۡرُصُوۡنَؕ‏

words.translation: we would not have worshipped them
we would not have worshipped them

ayahs.translation: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-qaaloo law shaaa'ar Rahmaanu maa 'abadnaahum; maa lahum bithaalika min 'ilmin in hum illaa yakhrusoon
ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “Had the Most Gracious willed, we would not have worshiped them.” But they have no knowledge of that; they are merely guessing.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمۡ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡ كِتٰبًا مِّنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ فَهُمۡ بِهٖ مُسۡتَمۡسِكُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?
ayahs.transliteration: Am aatainaahum Kitaaban min qablihee fahum bihee mustamsikoon
ayahs.translationClear: Or have We given them a book prior to this one, to which they adhere?

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلۡ قَالُـوۡۤا اِنَّا وَجَدۡنَاۤ اٰبَآءَنَا عَلٰٓى اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰٓى اٰثٰرِهِمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
ayahs.transliteration: Bal qaalooo innaa wajadnaaa aabaaa'anaa 'alaaa ummatinw Wa-innaa 'alaaa aasaarihim muhtadoon
ayahs.translationClear: But they say, “We found our parents on a course, and we are guided in their footsteps.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَذٰلِكَ مَاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فِىۡ قَرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍ اِلَّا قَالَ مُتۡرَفُوۡهَاۤ اِنَّا وَجَدۡنَاۤ اٰبَآءَنَا عَلٰٓى اُمَّةٍ وَّاِنَّا عَلٰٓى اٰثٰرِهِمۡ مُّقۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-kathaalika maaa arsalnaa min qablika fee qaryatim min natheerin illaa qaala mutrafoohaaa innaa wajadnaaa aabaaa'anaa 'alaaa ummatinw Wa-innaa 'alaaa aasaarihim muqtadoon
ayahs.translationClear: Likewise, We sent no warner before you to any town, but the wealthy among them said, “We found our parents on a course, and we are following in their footsteps.”

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ قَـٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ قَـٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ‌ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قٰلَ اَوَلَوۡ جِئۡتُكُمۡ بِاَهۡدٰى مِمَّا وَجَدْتُّمۡ عَلَيۡهِ اٰبَآءَكُمۡ​ ؕ قَالُوۡۤا اِنَّا بِمَاۤ اُرۡسِلۡـتُمۡ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala awa-law ji'tukum bi-ahdaa mimmaa wajatdtum 'alaihi aabaaa'akum qaalooo innaa bimaaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon
ayahs.translationClear: He would say, “Even if I bring you better guidance than what you found your parents following?” They would say, “We reject what you are sent with.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ‌ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فَانْتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ​ فَانْظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
ayahs.transliteration: Fantaqamnaa minhum fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mukaththibeen
ayahs.translationClear: So We wreaked vengeance upon them. Behold, then, what was the fate of those who deny.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذۡ قَالَ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُ لِاَبِيۡهِ وَقَوۡمِهٖۤ اِنَّنِىۡ بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.translation: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ith qaala Ibraaheemu li-abeehi Wa-qawmiheee innanee baraaa'un mimmaa ta'budoon
ayahs.translationClear: When Abraham said to his father and his people, “I am innocent of what you worship.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا الَّذِىۡ فَطَرَنِىۡ فَاِنَّهٗ سَيَهۡدِيۡنِ‏
ayahs.translation: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
ayahs.transliteration: Illal lathee fataranee fa-innahoo sa-yahdeen
ayahs.translationClear: Except for Him who created me, for He will guide me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَ جَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِىۡ عَقِبِهٖ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And he made it[1436] a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-ja'alahaa kalimatan baaqiyatan fee 'aqibihee la-'allahum yarji'oon

footnotes.1436: i.e., his testimony that none is worthy of worship except Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: And he made it an enduring word in his progeny, so that they may return.

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ وَاٰبَآءَهُمۡ حَتّٰى جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَقُّ وَرَسُوۡلٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
ayahs.translation: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers[1437] until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.[1438]
ayahs.transliteration: Bal matta'tu haaa'ulaaa'i Wa-aabaaa'ahum hattaa jaaa'a-humul haqqu Wa-Rasoolun mubeen

footnotes.1438: i.e., one who is obvious with a clear message, meaning Muḥammad (ﷺ).

ayahs.translationClear: I gave these and their forefathers some enjoyment, until the truth and a manifest messenger came to them.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَقُّ قَالُوۡا هٰذَا سِحۡرٌ وَّاِنَّا بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-lammaa jaaa'ahumul haqqu qaaloo haathaa sihrunw Wa-innaa bihee kaafiroon
ayahs.translationClear: But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is sorcery, and we refuse to believe in it.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنُ عَلٰى رَجُلٍ مِّنَ الۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيۡمٍ‏
ayahs.translation: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"[1439]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-qaaloo law-laa nuzzila haathal Quraanu 'alaa rajulin minal qaryataini 'azeem
ayahs.translationClear: They also said, “If only this Quran was sent down to a man of importance from the two cities.”

ayahs.textUthmani: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَـٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ‌ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا‌ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَـٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا‌ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُوۡنَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَ​ ؕ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُمۡ مَّعِيۡشَتَهُمۡ فِى الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٍ دَرَجٰتٍ لِّيَـتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ بَعۡضًا سُخۡرِيًّا​ ؕ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٌ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
ayahs.transliteration: A-hum yaqsimoona rahmata Rabbik; Nahnu qasamnaa bainahum ma'eeshatahum fil hayaatid dunyaa Wa-rafa'naa ba'dahum fawqa ba'din darajaatin li-yattakhitha ba'duhum ba'dan sukhriyyaa; Wa-rahmatu Rabbika khairun mimmaa yajma'oon
ayahs.translationClear: Is it they who allocate the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have allocated their livelihood in this life, and We elevated some of them in rank above others, that some of them would take others in service. But your Lord’s mercy is better than what they amass.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوۡلَاۤ اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ النَّاسُ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً لَّجَـعَلۡنَا لِمَنۡ يَّكۡفُرُ بِالرَّحۡمٰنِ لِبُيُوۡتِهِمۡ سُقُفًا مِّنۡ فِضَّةٍ وَّمَعَارِجَ عَلَيۡهَا يَظۡهَرُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.translation: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers],[1440] We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-law-laaa aien yakoonan naasu ummatanw waahidatan laja'alnaa limaien yakfuru bir-Rahmaani li-buyootihim suqufan min fiddatinw Wa-ma'aarija 'alaihaa yazharoon

footnotes.1440: Who assumed that Allāh's generosity to them was a sign of His approval or who would hasten to disbelief in order to obtain wealth.

ayahs.translationClear: Were it not that humanity would become a single community, We would have provided those who disbelieve in the Most Gracious with roofs of silver to their houses, and stairways by which they ascend.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلِبُيُوۡتِهِمۡ اَبۡوَابًا وَّسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِــُٔوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.translation: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-li-buyootihim abwaabanw Wa-sururan 'alaihaa yattaki'oon
ayahs.translationClear: And doors to their houses, and furnishings on which they recline.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَزُخْرُفًا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَزُخْرُفًا‌ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا‌ۚ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَزُخۡرُفًا​ ؕ وَاِنۡ كُلُّ ذٰ لِكَ لَمَّا مَتَاعُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا​ ؕ وَالۡاٰخِرَةُ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-zukhrufaa; Wa-in kullu thaalika lammaa mataa'ul hayaatid dunyaa; wal-aakhiratu 'inda Rabbika lilmuttaqeen
ayahs.translationClear: And decorations. Yet all that is nothing but the stuff of this life. Yet the Hereafter, with your Lord, is for the righteous.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَنۡ يَّعۡشُ عَنۡ ذِكۡرِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ نُقَيِّضۡ لَهٗ شَيۡطٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهٗ قَرِيۡنٌ‏
ayahs.translation: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maien ya'shu 'an thikrir Rahmaani nuqaiyid lahoo Shaitaanan fahuwa lahoo qareen
ayahs.translationClear: Whoever shuns the remembrance of the Most Gracious, We assign for him a devil, to be his companion.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَيَصُدُّوۡنَهُمۡ عَنِ السَّبِيۡلِ وَيَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّهُمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-innahum la-yasuddoo-nahum 'anis sabeeli Wa-yahsaboona annahum muhtadoon
ayahs.translationClear: They hinder them from the path, though they think they are guided.

ayahs.textUthmani: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: حَتّٰٓى اِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِىۡ وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ الۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ الۡقَرِيۡنُ‏
ayahs.translation: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."
ayahs.transliteration: Hattaaa ithaa jaaa'anaa qaala yaa-laita bainee Wa-bainaka bu'dal mashriqaini fabi'sal qareen
ayahs.translationClear: Until, when he comes to Us, he will say, “If only there were between me and you the distance of the two Easts.” What an evil companion!

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَنۡ يَّنۡفَعَكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ اِذْ ظَّلَمۡتُمۡ اَنَّكُمۡ فِى الۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-lai yanfa'akumul Yawma ith zalamtum annakum fil 'athaabi mushtarikoon
ayahs.translationClear: It will not benefit you on that Day, since you did wrong. You are partners in the suffering.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفَاَنۡتَ تُسۡمِعُ الصُّمَّ اَوۡ تَهۡدِى الۡعُمۡىَ وَمَنۡ كَانَ فِىۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ‏
ayahs.translation: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muḥammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
ayahs.transliteration: Afa-anta tusmi'us summa aw tahdil 'umya Wa-man kaana fee dalaalin mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind, and him who is in evident error?

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِمَّا نَذۡهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَاِنَّا مِنۡهُمۡ مُّنۡتَقِمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.translation: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa-immaa nathhabanna bika fa-innaa minhum muntaqimoon
ayahs.translationClear: Even if We take you away, We will wreak vengeance upon them.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَـٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَـٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوۡ نُرِيَنَّكَ الَّذِىۡ وَعَدۡنٰهُمۡ فَاِنَّا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مُّقۡتَدِرُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.transliteration: Aw nuriyannakal lathee wa'adnaahum fa-innaa 'alaihim muqtadiroon
ayahs.translationClear: Or show you what We have promised them; for We have absolute power over them.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ‌ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاسۡتَمۡسِكۡ بِالَّذِىۡۤ اُوۡحِىَ اِلَيۡكَ​ ۚ اِنَّكَ عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: Fastamsik billatheee oohiya ilaika innaka 'alaa Siraatin Mustaqeem
ayahs.translationClear: So adhere to what is revealed to you. You are upon a straight path.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ‌ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّهٗ لَذِكۡرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوۡمِكَ​ ۚ وَسَوۡفَ تُسۡـَٔـلُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it is a remembrance[1441] for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-innahoo la-thikrun laka Wa-liqawmika Wa-sawfa tus'aloon
ayahs.translationClear: It is a message for you, and for your people; and you will be questioned.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ءَالِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ءَالِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَسۡـــَٔلۡ مَنۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ مِنۡ رُّسُلِنَاۤ اَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنِ اٰلِهَةً يُّعۡبَدُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
ayahs.transliteration: Was'al man arsalnaa min qablika mir Rusulinaaa 'a-ja'alnaa min doonir Rahmaani aalihatany yu'badoon
ayahs.translationClear: Ask those of Our messengers We sent before you: “Did We appoint gods besides the Most Gracious to be worshiped?”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مُوۡسٰى بِاٰيٰتِنَاۤ اِلٰى فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۫ٮِٕه فَقَالَ اِنِّىۡ رَسُوۡلُ رَبِّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-laqad arsalnaa Moosaa bi-aayaatinaaa ilaa Fir'awna Wa-mala'ihee faqaala innee Rasoolu Rabbil 'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: We sent Moses with Our revelations to Pharaoh and his dignitaries. He said, “I am the messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ بِاٰيٰتِنَاۤ اِذَا هُمۡ مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
ayahs.transliteration: Falamma jaaa'ahum bi-aayaatinaaa ithaa hum minhaa yadhakoon
ayahs.translationClear: But when he showed them Our signs, they started laughing at them.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا‌ۖ وَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا نُرِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اٰيَةٍ اِلَّا هِىَ اَكۡبَرُ مِنۡ اُخۡتِهَا​ وَ اَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ بِالۡعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maa nureehim min aayatin illaa hiya akbaru min ukhtihaa Wa-akhathnaahum bil'athaabi la'allahum yarji'oon
ayahs.translationClear: Each sign We showed them was more marvelous than its counterpart. And We afflicted them with the plagues, so that they may repent.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوۡا يٰۤاَيُّهَ السَّاحِرُ ادۡعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِنۡدَكَ​ۚ اِنَّنَا لَمُهۡتَدُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-qaaloo yaaa ayyuhas saahirud'u lanaa Rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indaka innanaa lamuhtadoon
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “O sorcerer, pray to your Lord for us, according to His pledge to you, and then we will be guided.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ الۡعَذَابَ اِذَا هُمۡ يَنۡكُثُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
ayahs.transliteration: Falammaa kashafnaa 'anhumul 'athaaba ithaa hum yankusoon
ayahs.translationClear: But when We lifted the torment from them, they immediately broke their promise.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ‌ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنَادٰى فِرۡعَوۡنُ فِىۡ قَوۡمِهٖ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اَلَيۡسَ لِىۡ مُلۡكُ مِصۡرَ وَهٰذِهِ الۡاَنۡهٰرُ تَجۡرِىۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِىۡ​ۚ اَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.translation: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-naadaa Fir'awnu fee qawmihee qaala yaa-qawmi alaisa lee mulku Misra Wa-haathihil anhaaru tajree min tahtee afalaa tubsiroon
ayahs.translationClear: Pharaoh proclaimed among his people, saying, “O my people, do I not own the kingdom of Egypt, and these rivers flow beneath me? Do you not see?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمۡ اَنَا خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ هٰذَا الَّذِىۡ هُوَ مَهِيۡنٌ ۙ وَّلَا يَكَادُ يُبِيۡنُ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?[1442]
ayahs.transliteration: Am ana khairun min haathal lathee huwa maheenunw Wa-laa yakaadu yubeen

footnotes.1442: That was true previous to his appointment as a prophet, at which time Allāh corrected his speech impediment.

ayahs.translationClear: Am I not better than this miserable wretch, who can barely express himself?

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَوۡلَاۤ اُلۡقِىَ عَلَيۡهِ اَسۡوِرَةٌ مِّنۡ ذَهَبٍ اَوۡ جَآءَ مَعَهُ الۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةُ مُقۡتَرِنِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
ayahs.transliteration: Falaw-laa ulqiya 'alaihi aswiratun min thahabin aw jaaa'a ma'ahul malaaa'ikatu muqtarineen
ayahs.translationClear: Why are bracelets of gold not dropped on him, or the angels came with him in procession?”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ‌ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاسۡتَخَفَّ قَوۡمَهٗ فَاَطَاعُوۡهُ​ؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Fastakhaffa qawmahoo fa-ataa'ooh; innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: Thus he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. They were wicked people.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّاۤ اٰسَفُوۡنَا انْتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَاَغۡرَقۡنٰهُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
ayahs.transliteration: Falammaaa aasafoonan taqamnaa minhum fa-aghraqnaahum ajma'een
ayahs.translationClear: And when they provoked Our wrath, We took retribution from them, and We drowned them all.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْـَٔاخِرِينَ ۝٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ سَلَفًا وَّمَثَلًا لِّلۡاٰخِرِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
ayahs.transliteration: Faja'alnaahum salafanw Wa-masalan lil-aakhireen
ayahs.translationClear: Thus We made them a precedent and an example for the others.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ ۝٥٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ابۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ مَثَلًا اِذَا قَوۡمُكَ مِنۡهُ يَصِدُّوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example,[1443] immediately your people laughed aloud.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-lammaa duribab nu Maryama masalan ithaa qawmuka minhu yasiddoon

footnotes.1443: Of a creation of Allāh which is being worshipped along with Him.

ayahs.translationClear: And when the son of Mary was cited as an example, your people opposed.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَـٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَـٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ‌ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا‌ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ ۝٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُـوۡٓا ءَاٰلِهَتُنَا خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ هُوَ​ؕ مَا ضَرَبُوۡهُ لَكَ اِلَّا جَدَلًا ؕ بَلۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٌ خَصِمُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?"[1444] They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-qaalooo 'a-aalihatunaa khairun am hoo; maa daraboohu laka illaa jadalaa; bal hum qawmun khasimoon

footnotes.1444: Implying that they must all be the same.

ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Are our gods better, or he?” They cited him only for argument. In fact, they are a quarrelsome people.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ۝٥٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا عَبۡدٌ اَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَجَعَلۡنٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىۡۤ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَؕ‏
ayahs.translation: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
ayahs.transliteration: In huwa illaa 'abdun an'amnaa 'alaihi Wa-ja'alnaahu masalan li-Baneee Israaa'eel
ayahs.translationClear: He was just a servant whom We blessed, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَـٰٓئِكَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَـٰٓئِكَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ ۝٦٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَجَـعَلۡنَا مِنۡكُمۡ مَّلٰٓٮِٕكَةً فِى الۡاَرۡضِ يَخۡلُفُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another][1445] on the earth.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-law nashaaa'u laja'alnaa minkum malaaa'ikatan fil ardi yakhlufoon
ayahs.translationClear: Had We willed, We would have made of you angels to be successors on earth.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ‌ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ ۝٦١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّهٗ لَعِلۡمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمۡتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَاتَّبِعُوۡنِ​ؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ‏
ayahs.translation: And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me.[1446] This is a straight path.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-innahoo la-'ilmun lis-Saa'ati fa-laa tamtarunna bihaa wattabi'oon; haathaa Siraatun Mustaqeem

footnotes.1446: i.e., follow the guidance and instruction of Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: He is a portent of the Hour, so have no doubt about it, and follow Me. This is a straight way.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ‌ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ ۝٦٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ​ ۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمۡ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ‏
ayahs.translation: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-laa yasuddan-nakumush Shaitaanu innahoo lakum 'aduwwun mubeen
ayahs.translationClear: And let not Satan divert you. He is an open enemy to you.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ‌ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ ۝٦٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَ لَمَّا جَآءَ عِيۡسٰى بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ قَالَ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُمۡ بِالۡحِكۡمَةِ وَلِاُبَيِّنَ لَكُمۡ بَعۡضَ الَّذِىۡ تَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ فِيۡهِ​ ۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡنِ‏
ayahs.translation: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom [i.e., prophethood] and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allāh and obey me.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-lammaa jaaa'a 'Eesaa bilbaiyinaati qaala qad ji'tukum bil-Hikmati Wa-li-ubaiyyina lakum ba'dal lathee takhtalifoona feehi fattaqul laaha Wa-atee'oon
ayahs.translationClear: When Jesus came with the clarifications, he said, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify for you some of what you differ about. So fear Allah, and obey me.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ‌ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ ۝٦٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ هُوَ رَبِّىۡ وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡهُ​ؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
ayahs.transliteration: Innal laaha Huwa Rabbee Wa-Rabbukum fa'budooh; haatha Siraatum Mustaqeem
ayahs.translationClear: Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him—this is a straight path.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ‌ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ ۝٦٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاخۡتَلَفَ الۡاَحۡزَابُ مِنۡۢ بَيۡنِهِمۡ​ۚ فَوَيۡلٌ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوۡا مِنۡ عَذَابِ يَوۡمٍ اَلِيۡمٍ‏
ayahs.translation: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
ayahs.transliteration: Fakhtalafal ahzaabu min bainihim fa-wailun lil-latheena zalamoo min 'athaabi Yawmin aleem
ayahs.translationClear: But the factions differed among themselves. So woe to the wrongdoers from the suffering of a painful Day.

ayahs.textUthmani: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ ۝٦٦
ayahs.textIndopak: هَلۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمۡ بَغۡتَةً وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
ayahs.transliteration: Hal yanzuroona illas Saa'ata an ta'tiyahum baghtatanw Wa-hum laa yash'uroon
ayahs.translationClear: Are they only waiting for the Hour to come upon them suddenly, while they are unaware?

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ ۝٦٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلۡاَخِلَّاۤءُ يَوۡمَٮِٕذٍۢ بَعۡضُهُمۡ لِبَعۡضٍ عَدُوٌّ اِلَّا الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ ؕ ‏
ayahs.translation: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
ayahs.transliteration: Al-akhillaaa'u Yawma'ithin ba'duhum liba'din 'aduwwun illal muttaqeen
ayahs.translationClear: On that Day, friends will be enemies of one another, except for the righteous.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ ۝٦٨
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوۡفٌ عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ وَلَاۤ اَنۡتُمۡ تَحۡزَنُوۡنَ​ۚ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: [To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
ayahs.transliteration: Yaa-'ibaadi laa khawfun 'alaikumul Yawma Wa-laaa antum tahzanoon
ayahs.translationClear: O My servants, you have nothing to fear on that Day, nor will you grieve.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ ۝٦٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَكَانُوۡا مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ​ۚ‏
ayahs.translation: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
ayahs.transliteration: Allatheena aamanoo bi-Aayaatinaa Wa-kaanoo muslimeen
ayahs.translationClear: Those who believed in Our revelations, and were submissive.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ ۝٧٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اُدۡخُلُوا الۡجَنَّةَ اَنۡتُمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُوۡنَ​‏
ayahs.translation: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds,[1447] delighted."
ayahs.transliteration: Udkhulul Jannata antum Wa-azwaajukum tuhbaroon

footnotes.1447: i.e., those like you. Another meaning may be "your spouses," i.e., the righteous among them.

ayahs.translationClear: Enter the Garden, you and your spouses, joyfully.

ayahs.textUthmani: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ‌ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ‌ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ ۝٧١
ayahs.textIndopak: يُطَافُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ بِصِحَافٍ مِّنۡ ذَهَبٍ وَّاَكۡوَابٍ​ۚ وَفِيۡهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيۡهِ الۡاَنۡفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ الۡاَعۡيُنُ​ۚ وَاَنۡتُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ​ۚ‏
ayahs.translation: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
ayahs.transliteration: Yutaafu 'alaihim bi-sihafin min thahabinw Wa-akwaab, Wa-feehaa maa tashtaheehil anfusu Wa-talaththul a'yunu Wa-antum feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.translationClear: They will be served around with trays of gold, and cups. Therein is whatever the souls desire and delights the eyes. Therein you will stay forever.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۝٧٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَتِلۡكَ الۡجَنَّةُ الَّتِىۡۤ اُوۡرِثۡتُمُوۡهَا بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-tilkal jannatul lateee ooristumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: Such is the Garden you are made to inherit, because of what you used to do.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ ۝٧٣
ayahs.textIndopak: لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيۡرَةٌ مِّنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: For you therein is much fruit[1448] from which you will eat.
ayahs.transliteration: Lakum feehaa faakihatun kaseeratun minhaa ta'kuloon
ayahs.translationClear: Therein you will have abundant fruit, from which you eat.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ ۝٧٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ فِىۡ عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوۡنَ ۚ ۖ‏
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
ayahs.transliteration: Innal mujrimeena fee 'athaabi jahannama khaalidoon
ayahs.translationClear: As for the sinners, they will be in the torment of Hell forever.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ ۝٧٥
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ فِيۡهِ مُبۡلِسُوۡنَ​ۚ‏
ayahs.translation: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yufattaru 'anhum Wa-hum feehi mublisoon
ayahs.translationClear: It will never be eased for them. In it, they will be devastated.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ ۝٧٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا ظَلَمۡنٰهُمۡ وَ لٰـكِنۡ كَانُوۡا هُمُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-maa zalamnaahum Wa-laakin kaanoo humuz zaalimeen
ayahs.translationClear: We did them no injustice, but it was they who were the unjust.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ‌ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ ۝٧٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنَادَوۡا يٰمٰلِكُ لِيَقۡضِ عَلَيۡنَا رَبُّكَ​ؕ قَالَ اِنَّكُمۡ مّٰكِثُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And they will call, "O Mālik,[1449] let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-naadaw yaa-Maaliku liyaqdi 'alainaa Rabbuka qaala innakum maakithoon
ayahs.translationClear: And they will cry, “O Malek, let your Lord finish us off.” He will say, “You are staying.”

ayahs.textUthmani: لَقَدْ جِئْنَـٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَقَدْ جِئْنَـٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ ۝٧٨
ayahs.textIndopak: لَقَدۡ جِئۡنٰكُمۡ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَلٰـكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَكُمۡ لِلۡحَقِّ كٰرِهُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
ayahs.transliteration: Laqad ji'naakum bilhaqqi Wa-laakinna aksarakum lil-haqqi kaarihoon
ayahs.translationClear: We have given you the truth, but most of you hate the truth.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ ۝٧٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمۡ اَبۡرَمُوۡۤا اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّا مُبۡرِمُوۡنَ​ۚ‏
ayahs.translation: Or have they devised [some] affair?[1450] But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
ayahs.transliteration: Am abramooo amran fainnaa mubrimoon

footnotes.1450: Conspiracy against the Prophet (ﷺ). The reference here is to the disbelievers of Makkah.

ayahs.translationClear: Have they contrived some scheme? We too are contriving.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم‌ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ ۝٨٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمۡ يَحۡسَبُوۡنَ اَنَّا لَا نَسۡمَعُ سِرَّهُمۡ وَنَجۡوٰٮهُمۡ​ؕ بَلٰى وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيۡهِمۡ يَكۡتُبُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers [i.e., angels] are with them recording.
ayahs.transliteration: Am yahsaboona annaa laa nasma'u sirrahum Wa-najwaahum; balaa Wa-Rusulunaa ladaihim yaktuboon
ayahs.translationClear: Or do they think that We cannot hear their secrets and their conspiracies? Yes indeed, Our messengers are by them, writing down.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَـٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَـٰبِدِينَ ۝٨١
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلۡ اِنۡ كَانَ لِلرَّحۡمٰنِ وَلَدٌ ۖ فَاَنَا اَوَّلُ الۡعٰبِدِيۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."[1451]
ayahs.transliteration: Qul in kaana lir-Rahmaani walad; fa-ana awwalul 'aabideen

footnotes.1451: Only supposing it were so, which it is not.

ayahs.translationClear: Say, “If the Most Gracious had a son, I would be the first to worship.”

ayahs.textUthmani: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ ۝٨٢
ayahs.textIndopak: سُبۡحٰنَ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ رَبِّ الۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُوۡنَ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
ayahs.transliteration: Subhaana Rabbis samaawaati wal-ardi Rabbil Arshi 'ammaa yasifoon
ayahs.translationClear: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, beyond what they describe.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ ۝٨٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَذَرۡهُمۡ يَخُوۡضُوۡا وَيَلۡعَبُوۡا حَتّٰى يُلٰقُوۡا يَوۡمَهُمُ الَّذِىۡ يُوۡعَدُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
ayahs.transliteration: Fatharhum yakhoodoo Wa-yal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo Yawmahumul lathee yoo'adoon
ayahs.translationClear: So leave them to blunder and play, until they encounter their Day which they are promised.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ‌ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ۝٨٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِىۡ فِى السَّمَآءِ اِلٰـهٌ وَّفِى الۡاَرۡضِ اِلٰـهٌ​ ؕ وَهُوَ الۡحَكِيۡمُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ‏
ayahs.translation: And it is He [i.e., Allāh] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-Huwal lathee fis samaaa'i ilaahunw Wa-fil ardi ilaah; Wa-Huwal Hakeemul 'Aleem
ayahs.translationClear: It is He who is Allah in heaven, and Allah on earth. He is the Wise, the Knower.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ ۝٨٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَتَبٰـرَكَ الَّذِىۡ لَهٗ مُلۡكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا​ ۚ وَعِنۡدَهٗ عِلۡمُ السَّاعَةِ​ ۚ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-tabaarakal lathee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal-ardi Wa-maa bainahumaa Wa-'indahoo 'ilmus Saa'ati Wa-ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.translationClear: And blessed is He who has sovereignty over the heavens and the earth and what is between them. He alone has knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you will be returned.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٨٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَا يَمۡلِكُ الَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِ الشَّفَاعَةَ اِلَّا مَنۡ شَهِدَ بِالۡحَـقِّ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: And those they invoke[1452] besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.[1453]
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-laa yamlikul latheena yad'oona min doonihish shafaa'ata illaa man shahida bilhaqqi Wa-hum ya'lamoon

footnotes.1453: That intercession is granted exclusively by permission of Allāh to those He wills.

ayahs.translationClear: Those they invoke besides Him are incapable of intercession; only those who testify to the truth and have knowledge.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ‌ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ ۝٨٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَٮِٕنۡ سَاَلۡـتَهُمۡ مَّنۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ لَيَقُوۡلُنَّ اللّٰهُ​ فَاَنّٰى يُؤۡفَكُوۡنَۙ‏ ﻿﻿
ayahs.translation: And if you asked them[1454] who created them, they would surely say, "Allāh." So how are they deluded?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-la'in sa-altahum man khalaqahum la-yaqoolun nallaahu fa-annaa yu'fakoon

footnotes.1454: Those who associate others with Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: And if you asked them, “Who created them?” they would say, “Allah.” Why then do they deviate?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ ۝٨٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقِيۡلِهٖ يٰرَبِّ اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ قَوۡمٌ لَّا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ​ۘ‏
ayahs.translation: And [Allāh acknowledges] his saying,[1455] "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa-qeelihee yaa-Rabbi inna haaa'ulaaa'i qawmul laa yu'minoon

footnotes.1455: i.e., the complaint of Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) about his people.

ayahs.translationClear: As for his statement: “My Lord, these are a people who do not believe.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌ‌ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٨٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاصۡفَحۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَقُلۡ سَلٰمٌ​ؕ فَسَوۡفَ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
ayahs.translation: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace."[1456] But they are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: Fasfah 'anhum Wa-qul salaam; fasawfa ya'lamoon

footnotes.1456: Meaning safety or security, i.e., "I will not harm you." This was before permission was granted for armed struggle.

ayahs.translationClear: Pardon them, and say, “Peace.” They will come to know.
